description.value:
This tiny metallic barbell is strangely heavy for its size. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+7 #spell attack roll]]{+7}.

  • Armor You gain resistance 2 to force.

  • Weapon After casting a spell by Activating the cerebral barbell, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[2[force]] damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Cerebral Barbell - Armor]

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Cerebral Barbell - Weapon]

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Telekinetic Projectile].
